description: This file defines the ProductReviewService interface, which provides methods for managing product reviews, including retrieving reviews by customer, product, and language, and fetching reviews by product and customer IDs.

classes.name: ProductReviewService
classes.description: An interface extending a generic sales manager service to manage ProductReview entities with methods to retrieve reviews based on customer, product, language, and IDs.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product reviews made by a specific customer.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviews for a specific product.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviews for a specific product in a specific language.

methods.name: getByProductAndCustomer
methods.description: Fetches a product review based on product ID and customer ID.
